name: Code Red
tagline: A rehearsed emergency stop for systems you own, gated behind your own confirmation
description: You register a small set of trigger phrases up front, and saying one never sets anything in motion straight away. The bot first lays out, step by step, precisely what it intends to carry out, then waits until you sign off as the owner. It is a panic button aimed at your own infrastructure and nobody else's.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
